title: Exact Finite-Field Fiber Counts
statement: Over every finite field F_q of odd order, every rational fiber has size 0, 1, or 3; writing N_j for the number of targets with j rational preimages, N_1+3N_3=q^3 and N_0=2N_3, with 6N_3=(q-1)(q^2+2) outside characteristic 3 and 6N_3=q^2(q-1) in characteristic 3.

members.title: Asymptotic S3 fiber distribution
members.statement: The normalized finite-field fiber-count distribution (N_0,N_1,N_3)/q^3 tends to (1/3,1/2,1/6), matching the proportions of elements of S3 with 0, 1, and 3 fixed points.
